code:
Resources:
  LtvDemoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: ltv-cloudformation-demo
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
caption: YAML, one resource type, one declared end state.

code:
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client("s3")
s3.create_bucket(Bucket="ltv-cloudformation-demo")
s3.put_bucket_versioning(
    Bucket="ltv-cloudformation-demo",
    VersioningConfiguration={"Status": "Enabled"},
)
caption: Two ordered API calls, no memory of what was done.
